summary: Free consultation, a named accredited specialist and many reviews are strengths, but conflicting numbers and leftover form text appear to cost you calls.

findings.problem: The page appears to show (02) 8005 3075 in the hero while the header and footer show (02) 8378 8585, and the hero link appears to dial the other number.
findings.cost: A client who dials the wrong or mismatched number may never reach you.

findings.problem: Form field names such as first_name, last_name and type_of_matter appear as visible text, and the mailto link appears to contain a stray space (info@jjlawyers.com.au%20).
findings.cost: A broken form and email link lose enquiries from clients who prefer to write.
findings.fix: Clean working form and email link.

findings.problem: The page repeats 'We're here for you 24/7' beside Mon to Sun 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, and the firm name appears as James & Jaramillo, J&J Lawyers, JJ Lawyers, JnJ and JJLAWYERS.
findings.cost: Contradictory hours and many names weaken trust and search visibility.
findings.fix: Accurate hours and one brand name.

findings.problem: The family law page appears to carry criminal and traffic reviews and an FAQ about criminal accusations, shows 221 reviews but about 20 testimonials, and many reviews are dated 2 years ago.
findings.cost: Off-topic and stale proof does little to win a family law client.
findings.fix: Family law reviews, fresh dates and matching FAQs.

redesign: One phone number, hours and brand name.
Family law specific proof and FAQ.
